reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text: This app is a rip off and will charge you instantly, despite offering a 7 day free trial. The demo I saw showed the person pointing the phone at their wrist, yet it actually needs a face scan. And all the measurements were the opposite of what is true. Told me I had a high chance of developing hypertension, when I actually have low blood pressure most of the time. Also told me I have a low chance of developing diabetes, when I am already diabetic! I canceled the subscription instantly, yet it tells me I have access to it for the entire year that I purchased. I have to wait until it posts to my credit card before I can dispute the charges, which I fully intend to do! Stay away!
